# Component library acceptance

Run `tests/godot-final-install-assets/package-source-core.mjs` with a real core
binary and `CRAFTMINE_GODOT_CACHE_DIR` pointing to the pinned verified engine.
Only the fixed author-controlled fixture is executed, headlessly in new temp
data. Verify selecting a door from the actual CRLF entry scene, whole-world
rejection, dependency/UID/package hashes, mismatched-base refusal, two atomic
cross-world installations, preserved collision/mesh and independent interact
state. No fake executor or candidate application is accepted as evidence.

Run `tests/godot-final-install-assets/package-ui-headless.mjs` for the native
request projection, export controls, operation-preserving retry, independent
repeat install and unsafe-text rendering. Pointer Lock/focus are disabled;
only DOM form scripts are used.

Final product acceptance must connect the root-owned native file gateway and
real executor: select a component, save ZIP, open a different world, import,
wait for an actual passed check, preview/apply through the existing candidate
flow, then repeat with a new identity. Record the actual model/build/application
receipts separately. This task's direct authored-engine test does not claim
that final end-to-end result.
